items.title: This Yoshitomo Nara Painting Just Sold for $15.9 Million at Auction
items.why: Top-end art demand is holding up, which points to collectibles and auction access as possible affluent card perks.
items.summary_ai: A Yoshitomo Nara painting sold for $15.9 million at Fair Warning, just above its high estimate.
items.take: Top-end art demand is holding up, which points to collectibles and auction access as possible affluent card perks.
